nodes.label: Q18: Which reading of the broader vision
nodes.explain: Brian's "it is part of my broader vision": the repository's product map supports two readings. (1) General record: the workbench owns one investigation record per study (question, evidence, analytical plan, method runs, findings, unresolved questions, reviews, next actions), separate destinations are the defect (map sections 1 and 3), and any rights-clear corpus can fill it. (2) Policy product: the map's sections 5, 7 and 9 describe the product as running from a policy question through appraisal to a reviewed recommendation, call Open Science "too weak to organize the general policy-analysis product", rule it out as the flagship, and make the next step a completed public policy decision case. Which did he mean?
